gaps.detail: No test applies several valid options in one edit (e.g. `edit 1 --title X --no-due --priority low`, or --title with --due and --priority). Add a CLI test in tests/test_edit.py checking all fields change together and the other keys (done, tags) and other tasks stay intact.

AC-4 says an unknown id is reported before value errors, but `edit 99 --due 2026-12-01 --no-due` (unknown id with the due/no-due conflict) is untested. In core.edit_task the due/no-due check could move before _find unnoticed. Add this case to test_ac4_no_field_and_unknown_id_are_errors, expecting 'error: no task with id 99'. (The `edit 99` no-option case is already finding tests-1.)

Strictness of --priority and --due inputs is not pinned by any test: `--priority HIGH`, `--priority ' high'`, `--priority ''`, and `--due ' 2026-12-01'` or a non-ASCII-digit date are rejected by the PRIORITIES membership check and by parse_date, but only urgent, 2026-02-30, abc and the empty due string are tested. Add parametrized invalid-priority and invalid-due cases expecting the exact 'error: invalid priority: X' / 'error: invalid due date: X' and an unchanged file.
